description: Call when the person gave a name or street fragment and you still need a record id before get_receipt. If several matches look plausible — or the API returns candidates — stop and tell the person; do not pick one. Find businesses on the record by part of a name or street address, across every market or in one. Returns up to 20 matches listed alphabetically, each with its id, address, market, and the receipt URL; never a receipt and never an order by quality. Then call get_receipt with the match’s license (or domain) and market. We verify source facts. We do not approve the booking.

market.description: Optional market slug from list_markets. Without it every market is searched.

q.description: Part of the business name or its street address, for example "fox's beverly pub" or "9956 S Western".

name: find_business
title: Find Business on the Record
